name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-plans
description: Holds an agent's plan: steps drafted, walked in order, revised, and followed from other sessions.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLANS_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Identity of this agent. Empty — the working directory of the server process.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLANS_BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a write waits for another session's write. Empty — 10.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_PLANS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: An explicit settings file, the only one read: when it is missing, no file is.
